title: The Nashorn JavaScript engine was removed in JDK 15 — javax.script getEngineByName("nashorn") returns null on 21
notes: getEngineByName("nashorn") returns null on JDK 15+, so evaluate() NPEs at runtime — a removed-API break that compiles fine but fails in production. The replacement (GraalVM JS, a dedicated rules/expression engine, or removing runtime eval of customer input entirely) is a security-sensitive SME decision. The invariant is that evaluate returns the formula's numeric result given base.
